# PMTE — Petroleum Machinery and Technical Equipment

Official website: https://petrolum.ae/

PMTE is Petroleum Machinery and Technical Equipment - L.L.C. - S.P.C., an Abu Dhabi contractor established on 19 January 1994 and based in Musaffah M36, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.

Core documented capabilities:
- Controlled demolition and decommissioning
- Excavation, earthworks and site preparation
- Marine works and underwater concrete-block removal
- Concrete cutting and asphalt removal
- Waste transportation and debris clearing
- Metal construction contracting
- Oil and gas field and facility support
- Equipment and technical supply

Primary service pages:
- https://petrolum.ae/demolition-company-abu-dhabi
- https://petrolum.ae/demolition-equipment-uae
- https://petrolum.ae/marine-works-abu-dhabi
- https://petrolum.ae/earthworks-excavation-abu-dhabi

Documented projects include Mina Plaza, ADNEC Phases 1–4, KMART Abu Dhabi, Mina Zayed buildings and harbour works, Saadiyat Bridge wall demolition, Al Ain Zoo earthworks, Fisherman's Wharf Phase 1B and regional ground works.
